ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( OR( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator", $Profile.Name = "Integration User", $Profile.Name = "Portfolio Management", $Profile.Name = "Corporate salesforce team" ) ), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Collection", OR( Remaining_Payment_Tentative_Date__c < TODAY(), Remaining_Payment_Tentative_Date__c > CASE( Green_Book__c, "GB", DATE( IF(MONTH(AddMonths(TODAY(),1))=12, YEAR(AddMonths(TODAY(),1))+1, YEAR(AddMonths(TODAY(),1))), IF(MONTH(AddMonths(TODAY(),1))=12, 1, MONTH(AddMonths(TODAY(),1))+1), 1 ) - 1, "GB1", DATE( IF(MONTH(AddMonths(TODAY(),2))=12, YEAR(AddMonths(TODAY(),2))+1, YEAR(AddMonths(TODAY(),2))), IF(MONTH(AddMonths(TODAY(),2))=12, 1, MONTH(AddMonths(TODAY(),2))+1), 1 ) - 1, DATE( IF(MONTH(AddMonths(TODAY(),3))=12, YEAR(AddMonths(TODAY(),3))+1, YEAR(AddMonths(TODAY(),3))), IF(MONTH(AddMonths(TODAY(),3))=12, 1, MONTH(AddMonths(TODAY(),3))+1), 1 ) - 1 ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Payment Collection Tentative Date must be between today and the applicable month-end: GB – next month, GB+1 – following month, GB+2/Blank – third month from Today.
